policy.body_payload: A payload visibly attached to the plant may disappear on the release frame. Do not draw it travelling through space.
policy.external_payload: Water, spores, flame, electricity, wind, beams, sound rings, dust and other external projectiles or effects must never appear in the body animation.
policy.separation: Body animation ends at anticipation, release posture and recoil. Runtime projectile and effect systems render everything after emission.

plants.name: 弹荚芽
plants.motion: stalk pulls back, cheek inflates, snout thrusts, recoil
plants.motionZh: 茎秆后收，脸颊鼓起，喷口向前一次，随后回弹。

plants.name: 松针兽
plants.motion: body crouches, crest opens, three needles snap forward
plants.motionZh: 身体下蹲，冠部张开，附着针束在释放帧消失，随后回位。

plants.name: 阔叶刃
plants.motion: hood coils backward then whips a broad leaf forward
plants.motionZh: 叶冠后卷，一次向目标方向挥出并恢复。

plants.name: 投栗藤
plants.motion: vine hoists nut overhead, full-body throw, empty-hand recoil
plants.motionZh: 藤条举起栗子，身体完成一次投掷；释放后藤端为空。

plants.name: 蒲公英簇
plants.motion: petals compress then two seeds pop free with a head recoil
plants.motionZh: 花瓣收拢，附着种子在释放帧消失，花头回弹。

plants.name: 爆米苞
plants.motion: husk clamps, kernel swells, mouth flashes open, explosive recoil
plants.motionZh: 苞壳夹紧，果核膨胀，嘴部一次张开，身体后坐。

plants.name: 鼓囊菇
plants.motion: cap bows, sacs swell, gills clap once, body recoils and settles
plants.motionZh: 菌盖下压，气囊膨胀，菌褶一次合拢，身体回弹。

plants.name: 露珠花
plants.motion: bells lift and fill, stems tip forward once, then spring back
plants.motionZh: 花铃抬起蓄势，茎部一次前倾，随后弹回。

plants.name: 霜铃兰
plants.motion: bells draw together, crystal blooms, sharp release and shiver
plants.motionZh: 花铃聚拢，晶体冠张开一次，随后轻颤回位。

plants.name: 电苔
plants.motion: crouch, crest gathers charge internally, body arches once and settles
plants.motionZh: 身体下蹲，冠部蓄势，躯干一次拱起并回位。

plants.name: 树脂果
plants.motion: fruit winds back, squeezes flat, mouth opens once, elastic recovery
plants.motionZh: 果实后摆并压扁，嘴部一次张开，随后弹性恢复。

plants.name: 花粉灯
plants.motion: petals close, core braces, petals burst open once and settle
plants.motionZh: 花瓣合拢蓄势，花心绷紧，花瓣一次张开并收势。

plants.name: 喇叭风花
plants.motion: trumpet leans backward, cheeks swell, bell flares once and relaxes
plants.motionZh: 喇叭花后仰，脸颊鼓起，花口一次张开并放松。

plants.name: 吸吸葵
plants.motion: body braces, aperture dilates once, then a cough-like reset
plants.motionZh: 身体扎稳，花口一次扩张，随后像咳嗽一样回位。

plants.name: 弹簧蕨
plants.motion: coil fully compresses then launches crown upward and rebounds
plants.motionZh: 弹簧身体压缩蓄势，冠部一次弹起并回落。

plants.name: 镜叶草
plants.motion: leaf rotates edge-on, snaps toward target once, then settles
plants.motionZh: 镜叶侧转蓄势，一次对准目标方向，随后回位。

plants.name: 分叉芽
plants.motion: heads pull apart, cross-snap forward, recoil independently
plants.motionZh: 两个花头分开蓄势，一次交叉前探，各自回弹。

plants.name: 传导藤
plants.motion: charge travels root-to-tip, tip lashes forward, nodes dim backward
plants.motionZh: 力量从根部传到尖端，藤尖一次前探，再由尖端向根部放松。

plants.name: 卷刺篱
plants.motion: whole hedge braces, front coil lashes out, thorns snap open
plants.motionZh: 刺篱整体压低，前端卷藤一次伸出，附着尖刺张开后收回。

plants.name: 南瓜盾
plants.motion: shield draws back, shoulder lowers, body slams forward
plants.motionZh: 盾面后收，肩部压低，身体一次前冲后回到根部。

plants.name: 咬咬藤
plants.motion: neck retracts, jaws open wide, lunge-bite, chewing recoil
plants.motionZh: 颈部回缩，嘴部张开，一次前探咬合后闭口回位。

plants.name: 愈愈菇
plants.motion: cap shelters inward, body gathers, cap lifts once and returns
plants.motionZh: 菌盖向内收拢蓄势，一次抬起张开，随后恢复。

plants.name: 弹性叶
plants.motion: leaf folds backward, stretches long, slaps forward, ripples to rest
plants.motionZh: 叶片向后折叠蓄势，一次向前伸展并波动回位。

plants.name: 诱香花
plants.motion: bulb draws inward, petals close, petals fan open once and relax
plants.motionZh: 花苞内收，花瓣闭合蓄势，一次扇开后放松。

plants.name: 向日葵
plants.motion: head dips, petals close, center aims forward once and settles
plants.motionZh: 花头下压，花瓣微合，一次对准目标并张开，随后回位。

plants.name: 电容果
plants.motion: plates clamp, body compresses, plates spring apart once and settle
plants.motionZh: 极板向内夹紧，身体压缩，极板一次弹开并回位。

plants.name: 炉心花
plants.motion: door shuts, belly swells, door kicks open once with body recoil
plants.motionZh: 炉门关闭，腹部膨胀，炉门一次弹开并带动身体后坐。

plants.name: 水葫芦
plants.motion: gourd squeezes from tail to mouth, mouth opens once, body reinflates
plants.motionZh: 葫芦身体从尾部向嘴部压缩，嘴部一次张开，随后重新鼓起。

plants.name: 复唱铃
plants.motion: bells wind back, swing through together once, overshoot and settle
plants.motionZh: 两个花铃后摆蓄势，一次同时摆过目标方向，轻微过冲后稳定。

plants.name: 嫁接芽
plants.motion: lower crown braces, upper crown gathers the motion, both lean once and recover
plants.motionZh: 下层花冠扎稳，上层花冠蓄势，两层一次共同前倾并恢复。
